orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sharad Kumar Sharma
orders.text:
WPSS No. 470 of 2018
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
(Via Video Conferencing)
Mr. Shobhit Saharia, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. Siddharth Sah, Advocate for the 
respondents.
This is an admitted writ petition, in which the 
pleadings have been exchanged.
This writ petition is listed on a Miscellaneous 
Application (IA No. 6342/2020), filed along with 
supplementary rejoinder affidavit, as preferred by 
the petitioner. The said Miscellaneous Application 
is allowed. Supplementary rejoinder affidavit is 
taken on record.
There is a simultaneous prayer made by the 
counsel for the petitioner that considering the age of 
the petitioner, who is going to retire soon, the matter 
requires an urgent consideration.
Considering the said request as made by the 
learned counsel for the petitioner, the matter is 
directed to be listed in the 2nd week of August, 2020 
for its final determination.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 21.07.2020 Mahinder/
